motivation: E019 and E025 explicitly omitted an additive constant. This fills that finite gap in plaintext feedback and tests sensitivity to alphabet-origin shifts. For b!=1 the constant can be absorbed into a plaintext translation; for b=1 it accumulates. Neither case supplies a historical key clue.
grid: a,b,d each1..28, all29 initial keys. Exactly636608 recipes/page. d=0 excluded because its a,b/key cases were already covered by E019 and E014.
algebra: Set x=P0. S0=0,q0=1,t0=0; S_i=C_i+b*S_(i-1),q_i=b*q_(i-1),t_i=1+b*t_(i-1). P_i=a*S_i+q_i*x+d*t_i. Initial key=b^-1*(x-a*C0-d), a bijection. No division by b-1, including b=1.
gate: All3 synthetic controls exact top1 in full636608-rule grid. One explicitly exercises b=1. Known LP controls excluded from frozen external model training; not blind historical evidence.
unknown_scope: All55 unknown rune pages LP2-00..55 except preserved numericLP2-50, page reset, normal order, no F skips. Recover all rune positions including the first.
model: Unchanged E016 external4gram, all eleven pinned Emerson essays excluding Self-Reliance and all LP text. No score tuning.
selection: Freeze greatest mean score over55page searches and all source output hashes before nulls.
null: 19 independent rejection shuffles preserving exact full-page rune counts AND adjacent-equality count. Every replicate runs the identical complete636608-rule search. Max100000 proposals per shuffle.
correction: Plus-one empirical p, Bonferroni55 for page selection. Exploratory continuation after prior families, not a project-wide confirmatory test. Zero exceedances trigger a separately preregistered larger calibration before interpreting a candidate.
memory: At most2048 candidate rows x1024runes in int32, dense29^4 scoring table, bounded100000 context cache. One process, no full search ensemble retained.
limits: Finite one-step affine recurrence only; no nonlinear substitution, F interruptions, route permutation, cross-page continuation or delay3. Negative result does not exclude broader feedback ciphers.
